name: Respiratory Distress
overview: Dust, mold, chemicals, or allergens in the barn or field can cause coughing, wheezing, or difficulty breathing.

steps.title: Move to fresh air
steps.detail: Get the person outdoors or to a well-ventilated area away from dust, fumes, or mold.

steps.title: Loosen clothing
steps.detail: Help them sit upright and breathe more easily.

steps.title: If they have an inhaler
steps.detail: Help them use it as prescribed. One or two puffs may relieve symptoms.

steps.title: Stay calm
steps.detail: Anxiety can worsen breathing. Reassure them and keep them calm.

when_to_seek_help: Call 911 if: lips or fingernails turning blue, severe difficulty breathing, cannot speak in full sentences, or condition worsens quickly. Go to urgent care for mild but persistent symptoms.
prevention_tips: Wear a properly fitted N95 or P100 respirator in dusty areas (grain bins, hay, barns).
Know the signs of silo gas and never enter a silo without proper precautions.
